import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.Set;

public class Main {
    static final long mod = 1000000007L;
    static int n;
    static long p, k;
    static int[] fa;
    static int[] cnt;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        p = sc.nextLong();
        k = sc.nextLong();

        Set<Long> s = new HashSet<>();
        s.add(0L);
        long ans = 1;

        if (k == 0) {
            for (int i = 1; i < p; i++) {
                ans = (ans * p) % mod;
            }
            System.out.println(ans);
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        fa = new int[(int) p];
        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            fa[i] = i;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            long shit = (k * i) % p;
            int x1 = find(i);
            int x2 = find((int) shit);
            fa[x1] = x2;
        }

        cnt = new int[(int) p];
        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            int z = find(i);
            cnt[z]++;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < p; i++) {
            if (cnt[i] > 0) {
                ans = (ans * p) % mod;
            }
        }

        if (k == 1) {
            ans = (ans * p) % mod;
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }

    static int find(int x) {
        if (fa[x] != x) {
            fa[x] = find(fa[x]);
        }
        return fa[x];
    }
}
